The '''United States House of Representatives''' is the [[lower house]] of the [[United States Congress]]. It has 1,527 members, elected every two years. No party holds a majority: after the [[2026 United States House of Representatives elections|November 3, 2026 elections]], the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] is the largest with 302 seats, followed by the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]] with 301.
